confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is less certain because July is peak season and Yellow Mountain scenic-area lodging runs higher than Tunxi. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from local bar and restaurant price levels relative to beer, since direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 2026-10-15 value (0.6955) comes from a search-result snippet that attributes it to the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page to verify it. An aggregator's 16 October figure (0.6947) could not be confirmed, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on lower-tier Chinese mountain-tourism cities such as Guilin and Lijiang, with Tunxi old-town pricing as the reference for budget and mid-range options. Accommodation reflects July peak-season demand in the Huangshan area.
